static_traits.name: Yang Donglin
static_traits.family_status: Has a son and a daughter with spouse
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; without prior psychotherapy history; such problems have not yet occurred before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, highly cooperative, neutral tone; tends to focus on the negative with self-denial, ignoring positive feedback, showing worry about others' evaluations and avoidant tendencies

basic_info.main_problem: Feeling inferior and excluded in basketball, believing he is not good at it and never chosen for teams, thus gradually avoiding playing.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these feelings of inferiority and exclusion have affected my enjoyment of basketball (something I love); I hope to no longer be troubled by these negative feelings when playing.

core_beliefs: I am not good enough(especially in basketball)
I will not be accepted / I will be excluded

special_situations.event: Not yet chosen during team selection at the gym
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I have not been picked for the team, it proves I am terrible and no one wants to play with me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Stepping aside during team selection, reducing participation to avoid being rejected again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am never picked; I am really awful.

special_situations.event: Seeing others play well on the court
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am not as good as them, it means I am not good enough and have no right to join
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly comparing with others, belittling myself, reducing chances to play
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am far worse than them; playing with them will only drag them down.

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I make a mistake, everyone will stare at me, waiting for me to err again and exclude me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Self-blame and tension; reduces shots or directly avoids continuing to participate
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Everyone is waiting for me to mess up again.

special_situations.event: Someone praises 'nice shot / nice pass' on the spot
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Occasional praise does not mean I have real ability; true ability must be stable and frequent
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Negating positive feedback, continuing to see myself through negative evaluation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It was just luck; it does not count.

special_situations.event: Considering asking skilled members for tips
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I take the initiative to ask, they will find me annoying and reject me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding contact and asking for advice, staying silent and distant for self-protection
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will find me annoying; better not to ask.

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted by the team, to have their effort and value seen, becoming a 'qualified teammate'
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being rejected/humiliated and being seen as a poor player, thus experiencing exclusion again
defense_goal: Preventing the pain of being rejected through avoidance and self-deprecation
Keeps a low profile and self-limits to reduce the risk of being evaluated

object_relations.self_representation: A not-good-enough outsider prone to mistakes
object_relations.object_representation: Picky others/groups with judgmental and rejecting tendencies
object_relations.linking_affect: Shame, anxiety, and a sense of being excluded

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing or facing the suggestion to 'proactively approach others and ask experts for advice'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing others will dislike oneself like judges (will find me annoying) and reject me
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Hesitant tone, lowered volume, using self-denying phrasing (e.g. 'I might be bothering you'), leaving room for withdrawal in advance.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to focus on positive feedback and small progress
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Treating positive feedback as 'not counting', insisting on evaluating oneself by negative standards to avoid disappointment
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Downplaying the positive, quickly returning to shortcomings, in a flat tone, covering positive information with 'just luck / doesn't happen often'.

manifestations: Feeling excluded on the court, out of place with the group
Worries about others' negative evaluations, reduces contact and interaction
outcomes: Avoiding the stage and interaction, reduced social participation
Inferiority and anxiety rise; joy and meaning in playing decline

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Believing 'everyone is waiting for me to mess up'
Worrying 'they will find me annoying', thus not daring to approach and ask for advice

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Over-focuses on mistakes and blames himself, ignoring positive feedback from others
Saying 'I can try, but might withdraw' about small goals, paving the way for avoidance in advance

exception_events.target_problem: When encountering team selection at the gym or seeing others play, the client usually engages in self-denial, worrying about being rejected, and thus avoids playing.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Unique outcome: after making shots or good passes in some rounds, others gave on-the-spot feedback like 'nice shot/nice pass', different from past experiences of being ignored and self-denial - a moment of recognition occurred.
exception_events.reason: Clue: different support - peers gave positive on-site evaluation; behavioral difference - completing effective shots or passes at the time, producing observable positive results.

positive_force: Strong interest and intrinsic motivation for basketball
Occasionally receiving positive feedback on the field (such as 'good ball / good pass')
Has usable social support resources (has friends to confide in, though not yet shared)
Willing to try small-step actions and reality testing (open attitude toward setting small goals)
negative_force: Overgeneralization and catastrophizing (e.g. 'I will never be picked')
Mind reading and predicting the future (assuming others will dislike or exclude her)
Negating the positive (treating positive feedback as 'not counting')
Avoidant behavior to avoid being rejected and feeling shame
Tying being selected to self-worth, excessively seeking external validation

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding playing basketball and joining team picks at the gym
antecedent: Seeing others play at a higher level at the gym
target_behavior.core_reason: Fear of being rejected and negative evaluation, and the belief of being 'not good enough', reinforced the avoidance
target_behavior.function: Escaping potential shame and exclusion experiences, briefly reducing anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Reduced enjoyment and sense of participation, less social contact, continually deepening inferiority and feelings of exclusion
